verdict.rationale: Many agentic-commerce operations are documented as programmatic. Catalog import runs through the v2 Product Catalog Import API with webhooks, orders are exposed via checkout.session.completed and the List CheckoutSessions endpoint, SPTs are created and revoked via API, and the MCP server exposes the Stripe API to agents. However, seller onboarding and per-agent consent are described as Dashboard flows, agent attribution in the API (agent_details) is private preview while the Dashboard offers tag/filter, and certain MCP write actions require human approval through a URL. No parity statement exists, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity guarantee, API-based seller onboarding and agent approval, GA agent attribution fields in the API, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
